intro: After obtaining the patrol information, Corporal Sethman directs you back to Lieutenant Doren. Delivering these findings brings crucial military intelligence directly to the rebels' commander in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Did Lieutenant Doren want you to report back to him with that patrol information?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It pains me to find out it was Merle who betrayed us. He has always been a brave soldier, and I had thought his heart was true. But it is a great relief to have found him out - with a spy like him among us...we would not last long against Colonel Kurzen.
